Tottenham have lost their first two Premier League games without scoring a goal and sit at the bottom of the league despite spending £320m in the transfer market this summer. De Zerbi's side had been better than Newcastle until Anthony Elanga struck the opener midway through the second half, with Spurs unable to respond and conceding another when Yoane Wissa hooked in from close range. The league-phase draws for both competitions were made on Friday, with Europa League clubs set to play eight matches, while Conference League sides will play six - an equal number home and away - between September 2026 and January 2027. Sunderland reached Europe for the first time in 53 years and will travel to the San Siro to face AC Milan, while Bournemouth , in their first European competition, will also host the Italian club. messages.text: 'A joke!' - Hussain fumes as day three at Lord's abandoned amid sunshine

metadata.summary: A seething Nasser Hussain said the umpires' decision to abandon play late on day three of the second Test between England and Pakistan was "a joke".
metadata.content: England vs Pakistan: Nasser Hussain fumes as day three of second Test at Lord's abandoned during sunshine | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content England vs Pakistan: Nasser Hussain fumes as day three of second Test at Lord's abandoned during sunshine Just 24.5 overs possible on Saturday of second Test due to bad light and rain; stumps called at 6.30pm despite sun shining; Dan Lawrence's sixth Test fifty, notched from 64 balls, features stunning six; watch day four from 10.15am, Sunday, Sky Sports Cricket Nasser Hussain Cricket expert and columnist Saturday 29 August 2026 20:13, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Nasser Hussain questioned the umpires' decision to end play on day three of the second Test between England and Pakistan with the sun shining at the time A seething Nasser Hussain said the umpires' decision to abandon play late on day three of the second Test between England and Pakistan was "a joke". Just 24.5 overs were possible on a gloomy Saturday due to rain and bad light, during which time England moved from their overnight 81-3 to 177-7 for a lead of 357 as they look to wrap up a series win. There looked to be a chance of more cricket when the sun began to shine late in the evening, only for the day to be officially called off just after 6.30pm local time, prompting heavy booing from spectators. messages.text: Root's dilemma: What is behind his lbw struggles?

metadata.summary: Does Joe Root have an lbw problem?
metadata.content: Joe Root: What's behind the England captain's lbw struggles after twice more falling foul at Lord's | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Joe Root: What's behind the England captain's lbw struggles after twice more falling foul at Lord's Joe Root has been dismissed lbw seven times across five Tests this summer, and nine times in his last 12 Test innings'; watch day four of the seond Test between England and Pakistan at Lord's, live on Sky Sports Cricket from 10.15am on Sunday (play starts 11am) Saturday 29 August 2026 19:39, UK Image: Root has been dismissed lbw seven times this summer Does Joe Root have an lbw problem? That was the debate during the rain-interrupted third day's play at Lord's, with the England captain twice succumbing leg before wicket during the second Test against Pakistan - taking his total to seven such dismissals this summer, and nine in his last 12 Test innings. "It's fascinating that even a guy of more than 160 Tests, who averages over 50 - one of the greatest players England have ever produced - teams will still be looking at that developing trend," Sky Sports Cricket's Michael Atherton said.
